infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Trackshpr uses the camera so you can attach a photo to an order (for example, a packed bag or a delivery proof).
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Trackshpr accesses your photo library so you can pick an existing photo to attach to an order or to use as your brand logo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Trackshpr saves delivery photos back to your library when you choose to download them.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Trackshpr uses your location while a delivery is active so customers can see the rider on the map in real time.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Trackshpr uses the microphone only when you use voice entry to dictate order details.
